cases.manifest:
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: combine
spec:
  description: "{{ {'a': 1} | combine({'b': 2}) }}"
  rules: []

kind: Role
metadata:
  name: urldecode
spec:
  description: "{{ 'hello%20world' | urldecode }}"
  rules: []

kind: Role
metadata:
  name: urlsplit
spec:
  description: "{{ 'https://example.test/path?q=1' | urlsplit('hostname') }}"
  rules: []

kind: Role
metadata:
  name: log
spec:
  description: "{{ 100 | log(10) }}"
  rules: []

kind: Role
metadata:
  name: vault
spec:
  description: "{{ 'synthetic-secret' | vault('synthetic-password', salt='0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef') | replace('\n', '|') }}"
  rules: []

kind: Role
metadata:
  name: unvault
spec:
  description: "{{ ('synthetic-secret' | vault('synthetic-password', salt='0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef')) | unvault('synthetic-password') }}"
  rules: []

kind: Role
metadata:
  name: default
spec:
  description: "{{ missing_value | default('fallback') }}"
  rules: []
